title.sl: Modalni glagoli v pretekliku: should have, can't have
title.de: Modalverben in der Vergangenheit: should have, can't have
title.it: I modali al passato: should have, can't have

goal.sl: Pogledaš nazaj: kaj bi bilo prav (You should have told me), kaj je bilo mogoče, kaj je gotovo ali morda bilo (It must have been Sam), in česa ni bilo treba.
goal.de: Du schaust zurück: was richtig gewesen wäre (You should have told me), was möglich war, was sicher oder vielleicht war (It must have been Sam) und was nicht nötig war.
goal.it: Guardi indietro: che cosa sarebbe stato giusto (You should have told me), che cosa era possibile, che cosa è stato di sicuro o forse (It must have been Sam) e che cosa non serviva.
goal.en: You can look back: what was right (You should have told me), what was possible, what surely or perhaps happened (It must have been Sam) and what wasn't necessary.

say.sl: **should have** + deležnik pove, kaj bi bilo prav, a se ni zgodilo. **You should have told me.** ({m:Moral|f:Morala} bi mi povedati.) **shouldn't have**, kaj ni bilo prav, a se je zgodilo: **I shouldn't have said that.** (Tega ne bi {m:smel|f:smela} reči.) Tudi **ought to have**.
say.de: **should have** + Partizip sagt, was richtig gewesen wäre, aber nicht geschah. **You should have told me.** (Du hättest es mir sagen sollen.) **shouldn't have**, was falsch war, aber geschah: **I shouldn't have said that.** (Das hätte ich nicht sagen sollen.) Auch **ought to have**.
say.it: **should have** + participio dice che cosa sarebbe stato giusto, ma non è successo. **You should have told me.** (Avresti dovuto dirmelo.) **shouldn't have**, che cosa era sbagliato, ma è successo: **I shouldn't have said that.** (Non avrei dovuto dirlo.) Anche **ought to have**.
say.en: **should have** + the participle says what was right and didn't happen. **You should have told me.** (not *You should told me*) **shouldn't have** says what was wrong and did: **I shouldn't have said that.** Also **ought to have**.

examples.de: Du hättest es mir sagen sollen.
Das hätte ich nicht sagen sollen.

rows.de: wäre richtig gewesen, geschah aber nicht

say.sl: **could have** + deležnik pove, kaj je bilo mogoče, a se ni zgodilo. **We could have gone by bus.** (Lahko bi šli z avtobusom.) Tudi kot očitek: **You could have told me!** (Lahko bi mi {m:povedal|f:povedala}!) Nikoli **can have** za preteklost.
say.de: **could have** + Partizip sagt, was möglich gewesen wäre, aber nicht geschah. **We could have gone by bus.** (Wir hätten mit dem Bus fahren können.) Auch als Vorwurf: **You could have told me!** (Du hättest es mir sagen können!) Für damals nicht **can have**.
say.it: **could have** + participio dice che cosa era possibile, ma non è successo. **We could have gone by bus.** (Avremmo potuto prendere l'autobus.) Anche come rimprovero: **You could have told me!** (Avresti potuto dirmelo!) Per il passato non **can have**.
say.en: **could have** + the participle says what was possible and didn't happen. **We could have gone by bus.** Also to complain: **You could have told me!** (not *You can have told me*)

examples.en: We could have gone by bus.
examples.de: Wir hätten mit dem Bus fahren können.
Du hättest es mir sagen können!

say.sl: **must have** pove, da si {m:prepričan|f:prepričana}, da se je zgodilo: **It must have been Sam.** (Gotovo je bil Sam.) **can't have**, **couldn't have**, da se ni: **It can't have been Poppy.** (To ni mogla biti Poppy.) Tudi **won't have**. Nekateri rečejo *mustn't have*; v britanski pisni rabi velja **can't have**.
say.de: **must have** sagt, dass du sicher bist, dass es so war: **It must have been Sam.** (Es muss Sam gewesen sein.) **can't have**, **couldn't have**, dass es nicht so war: **It can't have been Poppy.** (Das kann nicht Poppy gewesen sein.) Auch **won't have**. Manche sagen *mustn't have*; britisch geschrieben gilt **can't have**.
say.it: **must have** dice che sei sicur{m:o|f:a} che è stato così: **It must have been Sam.** (Dev'essere stato Sam.) **can't have**, **couldn't have**, che non è stato così: **It can't have been Poppy.** (Non può essere stata Poppy.) Anche **won't have**. Alcuni dicono *mustn't have*; lo scritto britannico vuole **can't have**.
say.en: **must have** says you're sure it did happen: **It must have been Sam.** **can't have**, **couldn't have**, that it didn't: **It can't have been Poppy.** Also **won't have**. Some people say *mustn't have*; British writing wants **can't have**.

examples.de: Das kann nicht Poppy gewesen sein.

say.sl: **might have**, **may have**, **could have** povedo, da je morda bilo tako: **It might have been the wind.** (Morda je bil veter.) **She may have seen it.** (Morda je videla.) **They could have left.** (Morda so odšli.)
say.de: **might have**, **may have**, **could have** sagen, dass es vielleicht so war: **It might have been the wind.** (Vielleicht war es der Wind.) **She may have seen it.** (Vielleicht hat sie es gesehen.) **They could have left.** (Vielleicht sind sie gegangen.)
say.it: **might have**, **may have**, **could have** dicono che forse è stato così: **It might have been the wind.** (Forse è stato il vento.) **She may have seen it.** (Forse l'ha visto.) **They could have left.** (Forse sono partiti.)
say.en: **might have**, **may have**, **could have** say that perhaps it was so: **It might have been the wind.** **She may have seen it.** **They could have left.**

examples.en: It might have been the wind.

say.sl: **needn't have**: {m:storil|f:storila} si, a ni bilo treba: **I needn't have run.** (Ne bi mi bilo treba teči.) {m:Tekel|f:Tekla} sem. **didn't need to** pove le, da ni bilo treba: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.** (Ni mi bilo treba teči, zato sem {m:šel|f:šla} peš.)
say.de: **needn't have**: Du hast es getan, unnötig: **I needn't have run.** (Ich hätte nicht laufen müssen.) Ich bin gelaufen. **didn't need to** sagt nur, dass es nicht nötig war: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.** (Ich musste nicht laufen, also ging ich zu Fuß.)
say.it: **needn't have**: l'hai fatto, ma non serviva: **I needn't have run.** (Non c'era bisogno che corressi.) Ho corso. **didn't need to** dice solo che non serviva: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.** (Non avevo bisogno di correre, quindi ho camminato.)
say.en: **needn't have**: you did it, and it wasn't necessary: **I needn't have run.** **didn't need to** says only that it wasn't necessary: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.**

say.sl: Vedno **have** + deležnik: **You should have gone.** ({m:Moral|f:Morala} bi iti.) V govoru **should've**, **could've**, **must've**, sliši se kot *shoulda*, *coulda*, *musta*, zato ljudje pišejo tudi *should of*. Marsikdo reče tudi *should have went*. Pisno velja **should have gone**.
say.de: Immer **have** + Partizip: **You should have gone.** (Du hättest gehen sollen.) Gesprochen **should've**, **could've**, **must've**, es klingt wie *shoulda*, *coulda*, *musta*, darum schreibt man auch *should of*. Manche sagen auch *should have went*. Geschrieben gilt **should have gone**.
say.it: Sempre **have** + participio: **You should have gone.** (Saresti dovut{m:o|f:a} andare.) A voce **should've**, **could've**, **must've**, suona come *shoulda*, *coulda*, *musta*, perciò si scrive anche *should of*. Alcuni dicono anche *should have went*. Per iscritto vale **should have gone**.
say.en: Always **have** + the participle: **You should have gone.** In talk **should've**, **could've**, **must've**, which sound like *shoulda*, *coulda*, *musta*, so people also write *should of*. Some people also say *should have went*. Writing wants **should have gone**.

examples.de: Wir hätten zu Fuß gehen können.

title.de: Wer hat das Tor offen gelassen?
title.it: Chi ha lasciato aperto il cancello?

exercises.title: The sheep on the road
exercises.text: — The sheep were all over the road this morning! Someone ___ (must, leave) the gate open. — It ___ (can't, be) Poppy: she was at school. — It ___ (might, be) the wind. — The wind doesn't lift a latch. It ___ (must, be) Sam: he was here with the van. — You ___ (should, ask) him, then. Meg has brought them back, anyway. — Well, you ___ (could, tell) me! I ___ (needn't, run) all the way here.

translation.sl: — Davi so bile ovce po vsej cesti! Nekdo je gotovo pustil vrata odprta. — To ni mogla biti Poppy: bila je v šoli. — Morda je bil veter. — Veter ne dvigne zapaha. Gotovo je bil Sam: bil je tu s kombijem. — Moral bi ga vprašati. Meg jih je tako ali tako pripeljala nazaj. — No, lahko bi mi povedal! Ne bi mi bilo treba teči vso pot sem.
translation.de: — Heute früh waren die Schafe überall auf der Straße! Jemand muss das Tor offen gelassen haben. — Das kann nicht Poppy gewesen sein: Sie war in der Schule. — Vielleicht war es der Wind. — Der Wind hebt keinen Riegel. Es muss Sam gewesen sein: Er war mit dem Lieferwagen da. — Dann hättest du ihn fragen sollen. Meg hat sie ohnehin zurückgebracht. — Na, das hättest du mir sagen können! Ich hätte nicht den ganzen Weg laufen müssen.
translation.it: — Stamattina c'erano pecore su tutta la strada! Qualcuno dev'aver lasciato aperto il cancello. — Non può essere stata Poppy: era a scuola. — Forse è stato il vento. — Il vento non alza un chiavistello. Dev'essere stato Sam: era qui col furgone. — Allora avresti dovuto chiederglielo. Tanto Meg le ha riportate indietro. — Be', avresti potuto dirmelo! Non c'era bisogno che corressi fin qui.
translation.en: — The sheep were all over the road this morning! Someone must have left the gate open. — It can't have been Poppy: she was at school. — It might have been the wind. — The wind doesn't lift a latch. It must have been Sam: he was here with the van. — You should have asked him, then. Meg has brought them back, anyway. — Well, you could have told me! I needn't have run all the way here.

exercises.title: Sam's van
exercises.text: — You ___ (should, tell) me the van was broken. I ___ (could, walk) to Keswick in that time! — It ___ (must, be) the battery. — It ___ (can't, be) the battery: it's new. — Well, I ___ (needn't, wash) it this morning, then.

translation.sl: — Moral bi mi povedati, da je kombi pokvarjen. V tem času bi lahko šel peš v Keswick! — Gotovo je bil akumulator. — To ni mogel biti akumulator: je nov. — No, potem mi ga danes zjutraj ne bi bilo treba umiti.
translation.de: — Du hättest mir sagen sollen, dass der Lieferwagen kaputt ist. In der Zeit hätte ich nach Keswick gehen können! — Es muss die Batterie gewesen sein. — Die Batterie kann es nicht gewesen sein: Sie ist neu. — Na, dann hätte ich ihn heute früh nicht waschen müssen.
translation.it: — Avresti dovuto dirmi che il furgone era rotto. In tutto quel tempo sarei potuto andare a piedi a Keswick! — Dev'essere stata la batteria. — Non può essere stata la batteria: è nuova. — Be', allora stamattina non c'era bisogno che lo lavassi.
translation.en: — You should have told me the van was broken. I could have walked to Keswick in that time! — It must have been the battery. — It can't have been the battery: it's new. — Well, I needn't have washed it this morning, then.
